blocking_defects.defect: Shared by a and b. The ten placebo bars and the suite bar are drawn at identical height (34.0-36.6 s). That pictures a null result, i.e. the suite was no different from the placebo units. The verified source says the placebo permutation result was 'directionally consistent' with the main estimate but did not reach conventional significance (claim c6, empirical p 0.182 across 11 units). The picture states more than, and the opposite of, the reporting.

Shared by a and b. The stamp lands at 36.0 s and lifts at 36.2 s. The cut to the Camera rollout tag comes at about 36.7-36.8 s, so the four-word 'SHORT OF CONVENTIONAL SIGNIFICANCE' impression is held about 0.5 s. That is too short to read before the cut, so the first half of the performed turn depends on the caption.

b only. From 0.0 to 3.8 s the frame is a small abstract top-down floor plan in the upper half: a gray square, four camera icons a few pixels wide, a white table rectangle. The lower half is empty. The first change is a faint glow around the table (1.0-1.8 s). There is no visible anomaly at the board's 0.75 s hook payoff, and the operating room is not recognizable until the 3.8 s cut to the perspective room.
